body:
console.html renders the provisioning URL (which already includes the real PJSIP password) as a second, scannable QR code. app.js's onQrScanned() now detects that URL shape and routes to the existing registerFromProvisioningUrl bridge instead of the passwordless sip: URI parser. MainActivity.java + AndroidManifest.xml gained matching native detection and a VIEW/BROWSABLE intent-filter, so camera-recognizing the link also works. Deployed live (console.html synced to /var/www/carepyre, confirmed 200). Commit a31b18c.

⚓ ☃
title: QR onboarding zero-typing fix: provisioning URL now scannable (CAREPYRE-42143124)
